input.title: Add unit tests for JWT expiry logic
input.diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/auth/jwt_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+package auth
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestTokenExpiresAfter15Minutes(t *testing.T) {
+	tok, _ := SignToken(jwt.MapClaims{"sub": "u1"}, testKey)
+	time.Sleep(16 * time.Minute)
+	if _, err := VerifyToken(tok, testKey); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("expected expiry error")
+	}
+}
